summary:
Follow The Yellow Brick Road - US Debt Limit Revision
Welcome to Oz! While it is nothing new, now more than ever it seems the United States government is making a sport of changing the rules of the game while it is in play. This week, the revision of the United States debt ceiling serves as the primary example.

children.title: The People Behind the Curtain
children.summary: With increasingly wide‐spread politicization, it is interesting to note the reaction of crude oil prices and currencies to specific events over the past year and a half. The publicity of the Greek debt crisis rightfully created concerns about the weakening Euro.

children.title: CME margin hikes
children.summary: $/EUR Brent Crude WTI Highlighted in the recent Opinion, Uncle Sam's Slight of Hand , the United States government stepped in once again in attempts to defuse concerns over rising commodity prices by releasing Strategic Petroleum Reserves (SPR) stateside. The spread between West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the land‐locked benchmark contract, and Brent crude oil, which is typically thought to be a better barometer of international prices, has persisted.

children.title: Flying Monkeys
children.summary: The confluence of the series of policy changes in recent history will hopefully raise awareness among the public about decisions being made in Washington. The most troublesome element continues to be that America's future is being dictated by a select group of power‐hungry individuals that have personal motives at heart (read: re‐election).
